title: The all-day toggle creates an all-day event
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. You are on the Schedule page with the event modal open.
custom_steps:
1. Turn the all-day toggle ON.
2. Save the event.
3. Look at how it renders in day and week views.
custom_expected:
1. With all-day on, specific start/end times are not required (the time fields are disabled or hidden).
2. The event is created as an all-day block for that technician and day.
